title: Milkzard Reborn
description: Replaces all alchemy flasks in the Wizards Reborn mod with cute milk cartons :3
body:
Replaces textures in the **[Wizard's Reborn](https://modrinth.com/mod/wizards-reborn) mod**

All **alchemical flasks** are replaced with cute milk boxes with **cat** designs! 

The amount of drink in the flask is determined by the **remaining picture on the box** - the smaller the picture, the less drink

![Milk cartons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e37ba261ba29163d1172c6008f91334ccfe71b9.png)
